title: Saving an edit after another user saved the same term is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Start with the Credit Terms page open on the Active tab in both browsers.
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  4. In user B's browser, click "Edit".
  5. In user B's browser, replace the number in the Days box with 21.
  6. In user B's browser, click "Save Changes".
  7. In your browser, replace the number in the Days box with 28.
  8. In your browser, click "Save Changes".
  9. Click "Cancel".
  10. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Your menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Your "Edit Credit Term" window opens with term A's name and 14 in the Days box.

Step 3:

  • User B's menu opens.

Step 4:

  • User B's "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 5:

  • User B's blue information line says payment is due 21 days after the invoice date.

Step 6:

  • User B sees the toast "term A saved"
  • In user B's browser the term A row's Due reads "21 days after the invoice date".

Step 7:

  • Your blue information line says payment is due 28 days after the invoice date.

Step 8:

  • The app's error alert shows "Someone else changed this credit term. Reload the page and try again." The Edit Credit Term window stays open with 28 in the Days box.

Step 9:

  • The window closes.

Step 10:

  • The term A row's Due reads "21 days after the invoice date": the other user's change stands and yours was not saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 5 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • Story 2, Error Handling: “If a save is refused, the app's standard error alert shows the reason, using these exact texts: "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." (deactivating or deleting the default); "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (editing or deleting a term in use); "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated."; "Pick an active term other than Credit Hold." (making an inactive term or Credit Hold the default); "Credit term not found." (the term was deleted meanwhile); "Reactivate this term to edit it." (editing an inactive term; the row menu never offers Edit on one, so this shows only for a request sent another way); "Someone else changed this credit term. Reload the page and try again." (the term was changed by another user after the page loaded, and did not become in use or the default, S2-E2). The delete confirmation stays open when the delete is refused.”
  • S2-E2: “If a term becomes in use, becomes the default, or is changed by another user after the page loaded, the save is refused with the reason in S2 Error Handling, and the page keeps its state.”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If Create or Save is refused by the server, the app's standard error alert shows the reason (the S3-R9 texts, or "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." when no option is sent, or "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." when the term became in use meanwhile). The window stays open with the user's input.”
  • S3-R8: “On Save Changes, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} saved", and the row shows the new name and Due text.”
